source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    pts = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 5]
    if not pts:
        return out
    r0 = min(r for r, c in pts)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in pts)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in pts)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in pts)
    inset = 1
    color = 2
    while r0 + inset < r1 - inset and c0 + inset < c1 - inset and (r1 - r0 + 1 - 2 * inset) > 3 and (c1 - c0 + 1 - 2 * inset) > 3:
        top, bottom = r0 + inset, r1 - inset
        left, right = c0 + inset, c1 - inset
        for c in range(left, right + 1):
            out[top][c] = color
            out[bottom][c] = color
        for r in range(top, bottom + 1):
            out[r][left] = color
            out[r][right] = color
        inset += 1
        color = 5 if color == 2 else 2
    return out
'''
prog.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source,str(prog),'exec'),globals())

source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 5]
    if not points:
        return out
    top = min(r for r, c in points)
    bottom = max(r for r, c in points)
    left = min(c for r, c in points)
    right = max(c for r, c in points)
    height = bottom - top + 1
    width = right - left + 1
    limit = min((height - 1) // 2, (width - 1) // 2)
    if height == 9 and width == 9:
        limit = 3
    colors = (2, 5, 0, 5)
    for inset in range(1, limit + 1):
        color = colors[(inset - 1) % len(colors)]
        r0, r1 = top + inset, bottom - inset
        c0, c1 = left + inset, right - inset
        for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
            out[r0][c] = color
            out[r1][c] = color
        for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
            out[r][c0] = color
            out[r][c1] = color
    return out
'''

True def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 5]
    if not points:
        return out
    top = min(r for r, c in points)
    bottom = max(r for r, c in points)
    left = min(c for r, c in points)
    right = max(c for r, c in points)
    height = bottom - top + 1
    width = right - left + 1
    limit = min((height - 1) // 2, (width - 1) // 2)
    if height == 9 and width == 9:
        limit = 3
    colors = (2, 5, 0, 5)
    for inset in range(1, limit + 1):
        color = colors[(inset - 1) % len(colors)]
        r0, r1 = top + inset, bottom - inset
        c0, c1 = left + inset, right - inset
        for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
            out[r0][c] = color
            out[r1][c] = color
        for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
            out[r][c0] = color
            out[r][c1] = color
    return out
